latest.title: AWS: More Than Just Cloud Storage — Understanding Amazon Web Services & How It Works
latest.description:
What is AWS, and why should students learn it? ☁️
AWS (Amazon Web Services) is much more than cloud storage. It is a powerful cloud computing platform that provides services for computing, storage, databases, security, serverless applications, AI/ML, and much more.In this article, I explain AWS in a beginner-friendly way, including how cloud computing works and how services such as EC2, S3, RDS, Lambda, and IAM work together to build real-world applications.
